items.title: George Wein interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2001
items.q: So Ruby became the magic horn on television that Sal Mineo played.

ctx.x: I thought Jimmy McPartland was beautiful. But Jimmy didn’t have the greatest chops in the world but he had a great musical head and he could play wonderful music. But Ruby had chops as strong as an elephant or a crocodile, he had chops. He could bite you like a crocodile too. So Ruby became the magic horn on television that Sal Mineo played. But that’s nice to find that record. That’s good.
Yeah. That’s part of our collection at the college.
